context: Swaps the Mutex-guarded service registry for Arc<RwLock<...>>.
explanation: register (the rare write) now takes a write() lock while lookup (the frequent operation) takes a read() lock, allowing unlimited concurrent readers instead of serializing every lookup behind a single Mutex. ServiceRegistry is read-heavy and write-light by nature, exactly the workload RwLock is designed for, and the change is an API-compatible drop-in swap with no other call sites affected.
